fixed_design_shape_for_arithmetic.anchor: exactly after five source actions (S5); one reset plus five saved-action prefix steps to reconstruct each branch
fixed_design_shape_for_arithmetic.intervention: one Stage1 generation, one Stage2 generation producing one K1 action, then at most 44 P0 suffix steps to the original total horizon of 50
fixed_design_shape_for_arithmetic.P0_continue_from_S5: up to 45 P0 generations/actions per branch
fixed_design_shape_for_arithmetic.success_controls: optional 17 preselected among the 72 S5-usable source successes; control is P0 continuation only in the arithmetic below
fixed_design_shape_for_arithmetic.cap_source_note: 40/16/16 output and 8192 input ceilings are prior engineering/source bounds used only to calculate candidate maxima. A science protocol must explicitly adopt or replace them before launch.
fixed_design_shape_for_arithmetic.no_model_load_cost_hidden: Model-load count depends on the exact frozen actor artifact/process architecture. It is UNRESOLVED here and must be bound and separately capped; no cache reuse is treated as free.
fixed_design_shape_for_arithmetic.physical_environment_operation_definitio: one reset plus each actual step/action; environment construction and close are reported separately and are not included in reset-inclusive operation totals.

scenarios.comparison: The archived P0 suffix is a historical descriptive reference only; no fresh matched CONTINUE control is included.
This replays saved P0 commands without CONTINUE inference; it checks recorded-command/environment replay, not a new P0 policy decision and not a causal estimate of policy benefit.
A fresh P0 continuation arm is the prospective paired comparator; exact public S5 matching still does not prove identical hidden simulator/RNG state.

Success controls are prospective same-pool TRAIN development controls, not held-out identities. If success controls are also intervened on, add one intervention-branch cost per control; not included here.

candidate_hard_stop_envelopes_not_author.scope: three-arm 17-failure intervention + fresh failure CONTINUE + 17 positive P0 controls
candidate_hard_stop_envelopes_not_author.resource_accounting: Count all allocated devices times monotonic supervisor duration. This is a stop ceiling only, not a speed, capacity, free-memory, or exclusive-GPU estimate.

budget_warnings: The old R19/A96 and prior design ceilings are not reallocated. Only a fresh prospective user authorization can authorize any future call.

The three-arm maximum (18,939,904 input tokens) exceeds a 16,000,000-token candidate ceiling; do not silently transfer quota or reduce cases after observing outcomes. Freeze a new cap or choose a smaller arm set before authorization.
The 1.0/2.0 device-hour values are proposed fail-stop ceilings only. Shared GPU accounting and unproven PID-to-NVML mapping prevent estimating actual free capacity or inference fit.

Every reset, prefix replay action, K1 action, suffix step, and continue step is counted. An incomplete/unknown operation consumes its reservation and stops; no retry, resume, replacement, or automatic top-up.
Input-token maxima are formula ceilings, not measured prompt lengths. Actual tokenization/context length must be checked under a separately authorized frozen runtime before execution.
Model-load counts and actor artifact/process layout remain unspecified; freeze and meter them explicitly rather than treating loaded weights or cache as free.
pre_registered_stop_rules: No launch without fresh human authorization, a frozen exact proposal, independent exact-source review, and a distinct single-use clearance.

Before each case's first intervention action, exact S5 observation, full ordered action map, reward, done/truncated flags and event/command bindings must match the saved anchor; otherwise stop that case without replacement.
A source terminal at/before S5 is ineligible; do not replace the seven observed early-terminal successes or alter the sample after outcomes.
Stop on identity/register collision, unknown task alias mapping, replay divergence, invalid parser/action map, incomplete external operation, process/cleanup ambiguity, or any fixed cap.
Require trusted worker PID-to-GPU-UUID ownership before model weights load. If unavailable, do not initialize/load and stop.
No sample top-up, quota transfer, extra seed, repeated case, prompt tuning, effect-based recipe selection, training, held-out use, or G4/statistical confirmation under this design-only task.
